'''Pon Edestus''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who traveled to [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]] to hone his [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]].

==Biography==
Pon Edestus was born into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. He managed to free hundreds of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] in a slave revolt, although at the cost of his left arm. When he recovered from his wounds incurred during his revolt, he found out that he has been supplied with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm and his freedom had been purchased by [[Hethan Romund]]. Romund, a scholar, believed him to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] after witnessing him survive what should have been mortal wounds. She hired him as her bodyguard on an mission to a world purported to be the burial site of a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. The mission was a success, and Romund paid Edestus with the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the fallen master. Since then, he worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who fought in the name of the oppressed.

After Romund was captured by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sider]] [[Malefax]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Edestus joined with other individuals to rescue her.
